header.name: Healthcare Innovation and Entrepreurship Essentials
header.description: The objective of this course is to introduce students to the Healthcare Innovation with a specific focus on Digital Health and Entrepreneurship. It covers Biotechnology, Medical Device and Digital Health/IT. The course will aim to generate healthcare startup ideas after identifying the gaps and opportunities in the Indian and US ecosystem.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students can analyze and critique Digital Health and Health IT Startups in India and the US

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students can analyze and critique the Biotech and Biopharma Startups in India and US

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students can analyze and critique the Medical Device Startups in India and US

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students can create new ideas for healthcare startups

lecture_topics: Digital Health/IT startups- gaps, opportunities, regulations
Medical devices startups- gaps, opportunities, regulations

resources.title: Biodesign: The Process of Innovating Medical Technologies 2nd Edition (Yock, Zenios, Mackower et al)
